transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I just keep beating myself up lately. I work as a systems analyst, and I keep thinking that I’m not really senior material. It just feels like I’ve somehow fooled everyone at work into thinking I can handle a lot more than I actually can, and it's really starting to get to me.
Along with these thoughts, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

Yeah, I have. Most days lately, I've just had this heavy, low feeling. It's kind of like... I'm just moving through work and home with the color turned down, if that makes sense. Everything just feels a bit flat.
About how long have you been feeling this low and flat?
Well, looking back... I guess these low, guilty periods have been hanging around, off and on, for about eleven months now.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I usually really look forward to things like grilling on the weekend, or going fishing, or even just putting on a record. But lately... I don't know, I just leave all the stuff sitting there. I just don't really care about doing any of it right now.
Before these past eleven months, have you ever experienced another time in your life when you felt this down or lost interest in things?

Let me think... no, I don't think so. I mean, I've had regular bad days before, just like anybody. But feeling this low, or just completely dropping my hobbies? No, before these last eleven months or so, I haven't really experienced anything like this.

{"intent": "Assess for the presence of anxiety symptoms to evaluate for mixed anxiety and depressive disorder.", "question": "Alongside feeling down, have you also been dealing with significant anxiety, nervousness,

No, not really. I mean, I'm not feeling particularly anxious or nervous about anything. It's more just... feeling flat, like I said. Just no energy or interest in things, but not really worried or on edge.
Did a specific event or major change happen in your life around eleven months ago when these feelings started?

No, not that I can think of. I mean, work was going fine, nothing major changed at home. It wasn't like a sudden shock or a big event or anything. It just sort of... crept up on me, I guess. There really wasn't any specific trigger that I can point to.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, elated, or like you didn't need to sleep?

Well, before this whole low stretch started, there was a brief time... maybe for several days or so. I didn't feel elated, exactly, but I felt almost too sure of myself. And I was getting really irritable. Like, I would snap at people over really small stuff at work. If an email was slow to load or if a client asked the same question twice, I just had zero patience for it. I was definitely more revved up than usual, but mostly it just made me short-tempered.
During that time when you felt revved up and irritable, did you find that you needed significantly less sleep than usual while still having plenty of energy?

Yeah, actually. For a while there I was sleeping maybe... three or four hours a night? And the weird thing was, I was still getting up feeling totally ready to tackle the day. That is definitely not normal for me.
